tools.title: PLC Test Analysis
tools.description: Reads your test export and the test PDF to find the most-missed questions, then generates a reteach report for your team.
tools.note: Use this tool to ID most missed questions.

tools.title: Test Score Merger
tools.description: Combines test score exports from multiple class sections into one file, so you can analyze all your sections together.
tools.note: Use this tool to manage multiple sections.

tools.title: Missed It! Generator
tools.description: Builds a one-page report for students with the questions they missed, using an Eduphoria export and a blank test PDF.
tools.changelog: Early version. Features may change as it’s tested. Working on Cumulative Review.
tools.note: Use this tool to tell students what they missed on Eduphoria Tests.

tools.title: Accommodation Report Builder
tools.description: Quickly reads eSPED/504 PDFs. Requires you to be logged into Frontline, and use a temporary bookmarklet.
tools.changelog: Now works fully offline (PDF reader built in).
tools.note: Use this tool to easily find testing accomodations.

tools.title: MAP Growth to SummitK12
tools.description: Uses MAP reports to identify strengths and weaknesses. These can be used for assigning Remedial or Extensions in SummitK12, as well as used for SPED 3-week surveys.
tools.changelog: Early Version. May have changes after MOY and EOY MAP tests.
tools.note: Use this as part of CISD Science/Summit partnership.

tools.title: SUPER basic pdf editor
tools.description: No more googling for pdf editors. Type, erase, and save.
tools.note: Use this tool to fill out pdfs!
